name: Omni Core Plugin
description: Starter plugin that proves OmniClaw can discover manifest-backed plugins, validate plugin-owned config, and run runtime-declared tools.

setup.summary: Local manifest plugin loaded from the OmniClaw plugins directory.
steps: Merge defaults with persisted plugin config
Expose runtime tools when config is valid

health.summary: Ready when manifest validation and plugin config validation both pass.

tools.description: Echo a message through the plugin runtime.
Return a small status card from the plugin runtime.

surface.label: Surface
surface.description: Primary control surface where the plugin presents itself.

echoPrefix.label: Echo prefix
echoPrefix.description: Prefix used by plugin echo responses.

statusBadge.label: Status badge
statusBadge.description: Append a ready badge suffix to the status card response.
